command_scope: Frozen Campaign145 feature verifier over the published snapshot manifest with four workers
observed_failure: The generated verifier stopped at manifest semantics before reading a partition.
root_cause: The generated build wrote Campaign145's intended half_session_pair_count=119, positive_half_denominators_required=true and signed_return_and_amount_magnitudes_used=true, while the inherited verifier still expected the predecessor values 0/false/false. The inherited manifest writer also retained factor_ranges=[0,1] even though the frozen formula and per-partition validator permit [-1,1].
narrow_recovery_allowed: Freeze a separate verifier before another partition read. It must bind the original manifest bytes, require the exact known header discrepancy, validate every partition byte/frame hash and actual [-1,1] value semantics, recompute the aggregate digest, and publish an additive correction receipt without rewriting any snapshot byte.
